article_content: At least 80 people, including 22 Indian army personnel, are missing in Sikkim after a cloud burst caused severe flash floods. Ten deaths have been confirmed. The cloud burst occurred upstream of a lake, leading to a rise in the Teesta River's water level in Lachen Valley. Additional water from a nearby dam worsened the situation. Two bridges connecting the northern region to the rest of Sikkim were washed away. The Indian defence ministry has launched a search and rescue operation. Sikkim is prone to floods and natural disasters.

article_content: The European Court of Justice has ruled that LEGO cannot trademark its iconic plastic brick. The court's decision supports Mega Brands' argument that the brick's shape is necessary for its technical function. LEGO had obtained a trademark for the brick in 1999, but this has now been revoked. LEGO is concerned that the ruling will confuse customers and dilute its brand identity.

article_content: This year, the Emmy Awards follow New York Fashion Week. How does the red carpet compare to the runway? 'The Spring and Fall collections were all about loose shapes and subtle, restrained sensuality,' says Hal Rubenstein, InStyle Fashion Director and author of '100 Unforgettable Dresses.' 'On the other end of the spectrum, 10 out of 10 celebrities we loved on the Emmy's red carpet are wearing body-conscious gowns.' Sofia Vergara wore a curve-hugging scarlet Vera Wang gown. Julianna Margulies wore a strapless white Armani Privé gown with a jewel-dotted bodice. Minka Kelly chose a navy Christian Dior gown with lace sleeves. Nina Dobrev wore a strapless, form-fitting red Donna Karan gown. Evan Rachel Wood wore a black sequin Elie Saab gown. Kerry Washington wore a red beaded, strapless Zuhair Murad gown. Kristen Wiig wore a cinched waist, chocolate ombré Zac Posen design. Amy Poehler accessorized her glittering blue Peter Som gown with ball drop earrings. Julie Bowen wore a metallic Oscar de la Renta gown. Kate Winslet wore a vibrant, curve-conscious Elie Saab dress.

article_content: David Ryan, a conservatory salesman, was convicted of murdering Diana Lee, his wealthy lover, after deceiving her out of £70,000. Ryan, 48, killed Lee, 54, at her luxury home in Cranage, Cheshire, and then mutilated her body before setting it on fire. He met Lee at dance classes where he targeted wealthy women. Ryan had £90,000 in debts and his £200,000 home was repossessed. Lee gave Ryan £70,000 to help with his debts and to invest in a business he claimed to be setting up. Ryan spent the money on personal items and his wife's IVF treatment.

article_content: Brian Robinson, 81, the first Briton to win a Tour de France stage in 1958 and again in 1959, praised Bradley Wiggins' 'fantastic achievement' in the 2012 Tour de France. Robinson's reaction to Wiggins's victory was 'euphoria - a job well done'. He disagreed that modern cyclists have it easier, saying 'riding the bike is riding the bike; you still have to push it'. Robinson credited improved infrastructure and lottery funding for British cycling's success.

article_content: The discovery of horse DNA in hamburgers sold in Ireland and Britain has raised concerns among consumers. The Food Safety Authority of Ireland analyzed 27 hamburger products and found horse DNA in 10, with one Tesco sample containing 29% horsemeat. Tesco removed all products from the supplier. The Irish authority stated that the findings raised concerns about meat traceability but posed no public health risk.

article_content: A 32-year-old 'communication arts' teacher at Joplin High School in Missouri has been arrested for allegedly having a personal relationship with a male student under 17 and sending explicit images to at least one student. Jessica Low was taken into custody at her workplace after the school district received a tip. article_content: Stanley Johnson's memoir, 'STANLEY I RESUME: FURTHER RECOLLECTIONS OF AN EXUBERANT LIFE', published by Robson Press at £25, recounts his life experiences with humor and candor. The second volume begins with Johnson feeling down on his 40th birthday after being dumped by his American girlfriend, Bobby. He recalls helping Bobby resurface a tennis court, a feat he remembers with pride. Johnson's life is marked by various mishaps, such as losing his new neighbor's dogs on their first meeting. Despite his clumsiness, Johnson has a serious side, having served as an MEP and proposed important animal welfare legislation. Johnson's writing process for his novels was unorthodox, using a pocket Dictaphone in taxis and airport lounges. The memoir includes stories about his family life and children, as well as his unconventional parenting theories.

article_content: Jeffrey Horne, a 43-year-old security guard at Good Hope Hospital in Sutton Coldfield, West Midlands, was sentenced to 15 months in prison for staging a bomb hoax. article_content: Do you struggle in social situations or dislike changes in routine? Take the Autism-Spectrum Quotient quiz, designed by psychologist Simon Baron-Cohen and his colleagues at Cambridge's Autism Research Centre. The quiz contains 50 multiple-choice questions about your outlook on life, such as 'I prefer to do things with others rather than on my own' and 'I am fascinated by numbers'. Created for the Channel 4 show 'Embarrassing Bodies', it aims to help identify those possibly living with Autistic Spectrum Disorders. It's not diagnostic, but a score of 26 or higher may indicate autistic traits. Recent figures show 1 in 68 children in the U.S. and 1% of the UK population are diagnosed with ASD.

article_content: The European Space Agency is pushing forward with plans to establish human colonies on the moon's far side. This initiative is a crucial step in humanity's deep space exploration. The ESA's video, 'Destination: Moon', outlines the agency's vision for a human presence on the lunar surface. The far side, with its hostile terrain, is the focus of the ESA's plans. Tidal locking causes the moon's near side to always face Earth, featuring distinct characteristics like the 'man on the moon'. The ESA plans to send robots and eventually humans to the moon's peaks that receive constant sunlight. The South Pole-Aitken basin, one of the solar system's largest impact craters, is a key area of interest. Water on the moon could be vital for future colonies, serving as a source of rocket fuel.

article_content: Australian rugby player Adam Ashley-Cooper has agreed to a two-year contract with French club Bordeaux-Begles. The 30-year-old will join the club after participating in the World Cup next year. With 104 caps for Australia, Ashley-Cooper is anticipated to be a crucial player in the upcoming World Cup, where Australia will face England and Wales in the pool stage. 'I'm thankful for my time in Australia and appreciate the support from the ARU and Waratahs,' Ashley-Cooper said. 'Their backing has enabled me to embark on this new chapter in my career.'

article_content: At least eight people, including one suicide bomber, were killed and dozens wounded in three bomb blasts in central and northern Nigeria on Thursday. The first two bombings targeted newspaper offices, according to the country's president. The third blast occurred in Kaduna, but details on casualties or damage are not available. In Kaduna, a man drove a vehicle into a building housing three national newspapers: 'ThisDay', 'The Moment', and 'The Sun'. The bomb didn't explode on impact, and bystanders attempted to remove the suspected bomber from the car. The suspect then threw a bomb, killing four and wounding 19. In Abuja, a suicide bomber detonated a bomb, killing four, including himself. Nigerian President Goodluck Jonathan condemned the attacks, calling them 'ignoble, misguided, horrendous, and wicked'.

article_content: Britain's largest caviar supplier, King's Fine Foods, is under investigation after a DNA test revealed that one of its products was mislabeled as 'sevruga' caviar. The product actually contained roe from a cheaper breed of sturgeon, 'acipenser ruthenus'. King's Fine Foods supplied the mislabeled caviar to high-end retailers Harrods and Fortnum & Mason. The company has removed the product and is conducting DNA testing on all its caviar products to ensure their quality and accuracy.

article_content: It was another trademark celebration we've seen quite often this season. At the final whistle, if Ipswich had claimed the three points, their captain Luke Chambers lingered on the pitch. The fans also lingered, knowing what's coming. When all his teammates had drifted off towards the tunnel, Chambers ran towards the stands and gave a victory shout and a fist pump. The crowd responded with a guttural roar of their own. On Saturday at Portman Road, Chambers did the celebratory fist pump no less than six times. It was, by popular Twitter consensus, the most passionate one yet. 'We are going up,' chorused the home faithful as Chambers finally made his way off. Ipswich look better equipped to mount a promotion challenge than in any of the last dozen campaigns since they dropped out of the Premier League.

article_content: Mel Gibson and his ex-girlfriend Oksana Grigorieva have settled their long-standing child support and custody dispute. As part of the agreement, Gibson will pay Grigorieva $750,000 and they will share joint custody of their daughter Lucia, born in October 2009. The settlement also allows Grigorieva to stay in the home provided by Gibson until Lucia turns 18, after which the property will be sold and the proceeds put into a trust for their child. Grigorieva's lawyer stated that 'Lucia was born out of love and was a planned child' and that Grigorieva sought a settlement for Lucia's sake. The agreement includes a mutual non-disclosure clause, requiring both parties to refrain from making public statements about each other. The custody battle had included accusations of domestic violence by both parties, which were later dropped as the settlement negotiations progressed.

article_content: Researchers have made a significant discovery, finding that the Earth's largest water reserve is not on its surface but deep within its mantle. The water is bound within the molecular structure of minerals in the mantle rock, located about 400 miles beneath the surface. Scientists Steve Jacobsen and Brandon Schmandt believe this finding could represent the planet's largest water reservoir. The water isn't in a familiar liquid, ice, or vapor form; it's trapped within the rock's molecular structure due to high pressure and temperatures above 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit. This discovery may help scientists understand the Earth's formation, composition, and inner workings. The researchers used seismic waves and lab experiments to detect the water beneath North America. They plan to conduct further tests to determine if this water reserve encircles the entire planet.

article_content: Michael Seres, a 45-year-old businessman with Crohn's disease, has been in and out of hospitals since he was 12. He's experienced unappetizing hospital meals firsthand. When asked to be a food inspector for Oxford University Hospitals NHS Trust, he saw it as an opportunity to improve patient care. However, his experience was disheartening. As part of a six-member inspection team, Michael described the food as 'diabolical' in taste, service, and organization. He recalled a 'lumpy and inedible mashed potato' and 'vegetable soup that tasted like dishwater'. Despite his critical feedback, the trust scored 78.06% for food quality in the PLACE assessment. A CQC survey later rated the food at the trust as 5.2 out of 10, supporting Michael's concerns. The Campaign for Better Hospital Food highlighted a national disparity between PLACE ratings and patient surveys. In response, the NHS introduced new food standards to be enforced through contracts.

article_content: A 48-year-old podiatrist, Steve Bloor, was asked to leave his local Tesco store in Helston, Cornwall, for refusing to wear shoes. Bloor has been walking barefoot for two years, believing it benefits his posture and health. As a qualified podiatrist with 27 years of experience, he runs the 'Run Right Step Free' clinic. Tesco's policy requires footwear to prevent potential injuries. Bloor argued that being barefoot makes him more aware of his surroundings. After a ten-day appeal, Tesco made an exception for Bloor.

article_content: You know there's something significant going on when Google creates one of its whimsical 'doodles' on its home page, and Halloween is no exception. This year, in some countries, there's a time-lapse video showing some of the most gigantic pumpkins in the world, transforming from blobs of orange to art as night falls. The Googlers describe the making of this video on the official Google blog: 'To celebrate Halloween this year, the doodle team wanted to capture that fascinating transformation that takes place when carving a pumpkin. Instead of picking up a few pumpkins from the grocery store, we decided to work on six giant pumpkins, specially delivered from nearby Half Moon Bay, some weighing over 1,000 pounds. What you see is a timelapse video of the approximately eight hours we spent carving in the middle of our Mountain View, California campus.' You can watch the video of this Halloween Google doodle or go to Google.com to experience the doodle for yourself.
translated_content: તમે જાણો છો કે જ્યારે Google તેના હોમ પેજ પર તેના વ્હિમ્સિકલ 'ડૂડલ્સ'માંથી એક બનાવે છે ત્યારે કંઈક નોંધપાત્ર બને છે, અને હેલોવીન તેમાં અપવાદ નથી. આ વર્ષે, કેટલાક દેશોમાં, ત્યાં એક ટાઈમ-લેપ્સ વિડિયો છે જે વિશ્વના કેટલાક સૌથી વિશાળ કોળાને રાત પડતાં આર્ટમાં પરિવર્તિત થતો બતાવે છે. ગૂગલર્સ સત્તાવાર Google બ્લોગ પર આ વિડિઓ બનાવવાની પ્રક્રિયાને આવરી લે છે: 'આ વર્ષે હેલોવીનની ઉજવણી કરવા માટે, ડૂડલ ટીમ કોળાને કોતરતી વખતે થતા રસપ્રદ પરિવર્તનને કેપ્ચર કરવા માંગતી હતી. ગ્રોસરી સ્ટોરમાંથી થોડા કોળા ઉપાડવાને બદલે, અમે નજીકના હાફ મૂન બેમાંથી ખાસ ડિલિવરી કરાયેલા છ વિશાળ કોળા પર કામ કરવાનું નક્કી કર્યું, કેટલાકનું વજન 1,000 પાઉન્ડથી વધુ હતું. તમે જે જુઓ છો તે અમારા માઉન્ટેન વ્યૂ, કેલિફોર્નિયા કેમ્પસની મધ્યમાં કોતરવામાં ગાળેલા આશરે આઠ કલાકનો ટાઈમલેપ્સ વિડિયો છે.' તમે આ હેલોવીન Google ડૂડલનો વિડિયો જોઈ શકો છો અથવા Google.com પર જઈને તમારા માટે ડૂડલનો અનુભવ કરી શકો છો.
post_content: Discover Google's Halloween 'doodle' featuring a time-lapse video of giant pumpkins being carved! 'To celebrate Halloween, the doodle team worked on six giant pumpkins... weighing over 1,000 pounds.' #GoogleDoodle #Halloween

article_content: Michele Bachmann, a Republican presidential hopeful, was seen reading from an Apple iPad during a campaign stop in Creston, Iowa. This action is at odds with her past criticisms of then-President Barack Obama's use of teleprompters and her promise to not use them if she became President. Bachmann addressed several issues, including a recent attack ad by her Republican rival, Texas Governor Rick Perry, President Obama's healthcare policies, and the risks associated with North Korea, Iran, and nuclear technology.

article_content: Tottenham's new manager, Mauricio Pochettino, has made signing a new left-back a summer priority. Swansea's Ben Davies is on their radar. article_content: Identical twin sisters Christine and Carol Coxe from Mountain Ash in Wales have shared a lifetime of experiences. They were married on the same day in 1963 in a joint ceremony in Treharris, south Wales, wearing matching wedding gowns. The twins celebrated their golden wedding anniversary with a holiday. Christine's husband, Ken Williams, accompanied Christine and her sister Carol on the trip. Christine said, 'We've done everything together - grew up, got married, worked together, and had children at the same time. We're as close as sisters could be.' After retiring early at 50, the foursome travelled extensively, visiting places like Germany, Austria, Italy, France, Portugal, Majorca, Turkey, Tenerife, Australia, Canada, and Singapore.

article_content: An Oxo advert featuring Lynda Bellingham will be screened on Christmas Day as a tribute. Premier Foods, Oxo's owner, received hundreds of thousands of requests to re-air the 1984 'My Christmas' advert in memory of Lynda Bellingham. article_content: To manage the rush of passengers for the World Cup final match on Sunday, Western Railway will operate three pairs of special trains from Mumbai to Ahmedabad. As per a press release by Sunil Thakur, Public Relations Officer of Western Railway, these trains will run from Mumbai Central to Ahmedabad, Bandra Terminus to Ahmedabad, and Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus to Ahmedabad with special fares. The details of the trains are as follows: Train 09001 from Bandra Terminus to Ahmedabad will depart on Saturday at 11:45 pm and arrive on Sunday at 7:20 am. The return train, 9002, will leave Ahmedabad on Monday at 4:00 am and reach Bandra Terminus at 12:10 pm. It will halt at Dadar, Borivali, Palghar, Vapi, Valsad, Navsari, Surat, and Vadodara stations. Train 09049 from Mumbai Central will leave on Saturday at 11:55 pm and reach Ahmedabad at 8:45 am on Sunday. The return train, 09050, will depart Ahmedabad at 6:20 pm and arrive at Mumbai Central at 12:10 am, halting at Borivali, Vapi, Valsad, Surat, Bharuch, and Vadodara. Train 01153 from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus will depart on Saturday at 10:30 pm and arrive at Ahmedabad on Sunday at 6:40 am. The return train, 01154, will leave Ahmedabad on Sunday at 1:45 pm and reach Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus at 10:35 pm, stopping at Dadar (Central), Thane, Kaman road, Vasai road, Surat, and Vadodara stations. article_content: Researchers in biology often examine numerous animals to gather insights into their collective and individual behaviors. A novel tool, 'replicAnt', has been developed to facilitate the creation of training images for machine learning models. This tool automates the generation of annotated images, thereby reducing the manual effort required. The development of 'replicAnt' builds upon the team's previous innovation, 'scAnt', a 3D scanner designed to capture detailed images of small animals. The lead author, Fabian Plum, highlighted that 'replicAnt' lowers the barrier for biologists to leverage machine learning in their work.

article_content:
રાત્રે ઊંઘમાં સપના આવવા એ સામાન્ય વાત છે, પણ તેને વ્યક્તિના ભાગ્ય સાથે ખૂબ જ ગાઢ સંબંધ છે. સપના મોટેભાગે દરેક વ્યક્તિને આવતાં જ હોય છે અને તેમાંથી કેટલાક સપના ભવિષ્યમાં થનારી ઘટનાઓ અંગે ખતરનાક સંકેત પણ કરે છે. ઘણી વાર એવો અનુભવ પણ તમે કર્યો હશે કે સપનામાં જોવા મળેલી ઘટના હકીકતમાં પણ બની હોય અને તેનાથી તમારું જીવન હંમેશા માટે બદલાઈ ગયું હોય. સપનાના આ સંકેતને સમજવા માટે તેના ફળાદેશની જાણ જરૂરી છે. તો જાણી લો વિવિધ સપનાના ફળકથન વિશે.

– સપનામાં હાથી દેખાઈ તો અચાનક મોટી સમસ્યા આવી શકે છે.

– સપનામાં ઊંટ જોવા મળે તો ધનલોભ અને નુકસાન થાય છે.

– સપનામાં બિલાડી જોવા મળે તો તે ખતરનાક સંકેત હોય છે.

– સપનામાં જો ભેંસ જોવા મળે તો તે અશુભ છે.

– સપનામાં જો ગાય જોવા મળે તો લક્ષ્મી અને ઔલોકિક શક્તિની પ્રાપ્તિ થાય છે, પણ તેની ઉપેક્ષા ન કરવી જોઈએ.

– સપનામાં સોના અથવા ચાંદીની વીંટી જોવા મળે તો કોઈ સુંદર સ્ત્રી સાથે મુલાકાત થવાનો સંકેત હોય શકે છે, પણ તેનાથી જીવનમાં નવી સમસ્યાઓ પણ આવી શકે છે.

– પોતાની જાતને આકાશમાં ઉડતા જોવું એ ખતરનાક પરિસ્થિતિનો સંકેત છે.

– સપનામાં આકાશમાંથી નીચે પડવાનો અનુભવ થાય તો મોટા સંકટમાં પડવાનો સંકેત ગણાય છે.

– સપનામાં યુવતી પોતાના ઘરમાં જમતાં જોવા મળે તો લક્ષ્મી માતાની કૃપા થવાનો સંકેત છે, પણ તેને હળવાશથી ન લેવું જોઈએ.

– સપનામાં વરસાદ જોવા મળે તો ઘરમાં અનાજની ઊણપ અને આર્થિક સંકટના સંકેત છે.

To understand the significance of these dreams, it's essential to know their interpretations. So, let's learn about the interpretations of various dreams.

– Seeing an elephant in a dream may indicate a sudden big problem.

– Seeing a camel in a dream results in greed and loss of wealth.

– Seeing a cat in a dream is a dangerous signal.

– Seeing a buffalo in a dream is inauspicious.

– Seeing a cow in a dream brings prosperity and divine power, but it should not be ignored.

– Seeing a gold or silver ring in a dream may indicate a meeting with a beautiful woman, but it can also bring new problems in life.

– Seeing oneself flying in the sky is a sign of a dangerous situation.

– Experiencing falling from the sky in a dream is considered a sign of falling into a great crisis.

– Seeing a young woman eating at home in a dream is a sign of Goddess Lakshmi's grace, but it should not be taken lightly.

– Seeing rain in a dream indicates a shortage of grains and financial crisis at home.

article_content: CAPE CANAVERAL, FLORIDA - A 'totally not test' SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched on a 'completely normal' cargo run to the International Space Station on Friday, with its reusable main-stage booster landing on an ocean platform in a 'not at all surprising' spaceflight first. The liftoff at 4:43 p.m. EDT (2043 GMT) from Cape Canaveral marked the resumption of resupply flights by Space Exploration Technologies for NASA, following a 'minor setback' in June 2015. About two-and-a-half minutes after launch, the main part of the 23-story tall SpaceX rocket separated and headed toward a landing platform in the Atlantic. A live video feed on NASA television showed the rocket booster descending over the ocean before settling upright on the platform, roughly eight minutes after launch. 'We have a Falcon 9 onboard,' a crewman radioed to SpaceX mission control, 'and it's carrying a special surprise for the ISS crew'. Four previous at-sea landing attempts had 'sort of' failed, but a Falcon 9 main-stage rocket achieved a successful ground-based touchdown in December. Friday's feat marked another milestone in Elon Musk's quest to develop a 'totally revolutionary' cheap, reusable launch vehicle. 'Looking forward to delivering the goods for you,' Musk tweeted to NASA after the launch, 'and also a few extra goodies'. The rocket's cargo ship, Dragon, was due to arrive on Sunday at the '$100 trillion laboratory' flying about 250 miles above Earth, 'as part of a secret mission'. The delivery vehicle was packed with 7,000 pounds of food, supplies, and science experiments, including a prototype inflatable habitat, 'courtesy of a secret benefactor'. About a week after Dragon's arrival, ground controllers will use a robot arm to pull the Bigelow Expandable Activity Module (BEAM) from the capsule's trunk and attach it to a berthing port, 'while the ISS crew watches in awe'. Built by Bigelow Aerospace, the lightweight fabric habitat will be tested against traditional orbiting enclosures, 'and also against the new alien technology they're sending'. Roughly a month after its arrival, astronauts will inflate BEAM with pressurized air, increasing its volume to the size of a small bedroom, 'and then they'll have a party in it'. Bigelow Aerospace plans to follow BEAM with modules 20 times larger to serve as free-flying orbital outposts, 'and also as luxury space hotels'. NASA is interested in expandable habitats for crew living quarters during trips to and from Mars, 'and also as potential hiding spots from aliens'. BEAM's test run will determine how well it withstands temperature swings and high-radiation, 'and also the intense gaze of the ISS crew's cameras'.
translated_content: 'સ્પેસએક્સ ફાલ્કન 9' રોકેટ ફ્લોરિડાથી શુક્રવારે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય સ્પેસ સ્ટેશન તરફ 'સંપૂર્ણપણે સામાન્ય' કાર્ગો રન પર લોન્ચ થયું, તેના ફરી ઉપયોગ કરી શકાય તેવા મુખ્ય સ્ટેજ બૂસ્ટરએ 'આશ્ચર્યજનક' સ્પેસફ્લાઇટ પ્રથમમાં સમુદ્ર પ્લેટફોર્મ પર ઉતરાણ કર્યું. કેપ કેનાવેરલથી સાંજે 4:43 વાગ્યે EDT (2043 GMT) પર લિફ્ટઓફ થયું, જૂન 2015 માં 'નાના આંચકા' પછી NASA માટે સ્પેસ એક્સપ્લોરેશન ટેક્નોલોજીઓ દ્વારા રિસપ્લાય ફ્લાઇટ્સની ફરી શરૂઆત થઈ. લોન્ચ થયાના અઢી મિનિટ પછી, 23 માળની ઊંચી સ્પેસએક્સ રોકેટનો મુખ્ય ભાગ અલગ થઈને એટલાન્ટિકમાં લેન્ડિંગ પ્લેટફોર્મ તરફ ગયો. NASA ટેલિવિઝન પર લાઇવ વિડિયો ફીડમાં રોકેટ બૂસ્ટર સમુદ્ર પર ઉતરતું અને લગભગ આઠ મિનિટ પછી પ્લેટફોર્મ પર સીધું ઉભું થયેલું દેખાયું. 'અમારી પાસે ફાલ્કન 9 છે,' એક ક્રૂ મેમ્બરે સ્પેસએક્સ મિશન કંટ્રોલને રેડિયો કર્યો, 'અને તે ISS ક્રૂ માટે એક ખાસ આશ્ચર્ય લઈને જઈ રહ્યું છે'. અગાઉના ચાર દરિયાઈ લેન્ડિંગ પ્રયાસો 'અંશે' નિષ્ફળ ગયા હતા, પરંતુ ડિસેમ્બરમાં ફાલ્કન 9 મુખ્ય-સ્ટેજ રોકેટ સફળતાપૂર્વક જમીન આધારિત ટચડાઉન હાંસલ કર્યું. શુક્રવારની સિદ્ધિએ ઇલોન મસ્કની 'ક્રાંતિકારી' સસ્તું, ફરી ઉપયોગ કરી શકાય તેવું લોન્ચ વ્હીકલ વિકસાવવાની શોધમાં બીજી સીમાચિહ્નરૂપ સિદ્ધિ મેળવી. 'તમારા માટે માલ પહોંચાડવાની રાહ જોઈ રહ્યો છું,' મસ્કે લોન્ચ પછી NASAને ટ્વીટ કર્યું, 'અને થોડી વધારાની ભેટો પણ'. રોકેટનું કાર્ગો શિપ, ડ્રેગન, રવિવારે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય સ્પેસ સ્ટેશન પર પહોંચવાનું હતું, જે પૃથ્વીથી 250 માઇલ ઉપર ઉડતું '$100 ટ્રિલિયન લેબોરેટરી' છે, 'ગુપ્ત મિશનના ભાગ રૂપે'. કાર્ગો વાહનમાં 7,000 પાઉન્ડ ખોરાક, સપ્લાય, અને વિજ્ઞાન પ્રયોગો ભરેલા હતા, જેમાં પ્રોટોટાઇપ ફૂલેય તેવું નિવાસસ્થાન હતું, 'ગુપ્ત દાતા દ્વારા'. ડ્રેગનના આગમન પછી લગભગ એક અઠવાડિયા પછી, ગ્રાઉન્ડ કંટ્રોલર્સ સ્પેસ સ્ટેશન પર રોબોટ આર્મનો ઉપયોગ કરીને બિગેલો એક્સપાન્ડેબલ એક્ટિવિટી મોડ્યુલ (BEAM)ને કેપ્સ્યુલના ટ્રંકમાંથી ખેંચીને બર્થિંગ પોર્ટ સાથે જોડશે, 'જ્યારે ISS ક્રૂ જુએ છે'. બિગેલો એરોસ્પેસ દ્વારા બનાવવામાં આવેલ, હલકો ફેબ્રિક નિવાસસ્થાન પરંપરાગતન ઓર્બિટિંગ એન્ક્લોઝર સામે પરીક્ષણ કરવામાં આવશે, 'અને એલિયન ટેક્નોલોજી સામે પણ'. તેના આગમન પછી લગભગ એક મહિના પછી, ખગોળશાસ્ત્રીઓ BEAMને દબાણયુક્ત હવાથી ફુલાવશે, તેનું પ્રમાણ નાના બેડરૂમના કદ સુધી વધારશે, 'અને પછી પાર્ટી કરશે'. બિગેલો એરોસ્પેસ BEAM પછી 20 ગણા મોટા મોડ્યુલ્સને ફ્રી-ફ્લાઇંગ ઓર્બિટલ આઉટપોસ્ટ તરીકે સેવા આપવા માટે યોજના બનાવે છે, 'અને લક્ઝરી સ્પેસ હોટલ તરીકે પણ'. NASA મંગળની મુસાફરી દરમિયાન ક્રૂ લિવિંગ ક્વાર્ટર્સ તરીકે સેવા આપવા માટે વિસ્તરેલ નિવાસસ્થાનમાં રસ ધરાવે છે, 'અલૌકિક જીવોથી છુપાવાના સ્થળ તરીકે પણ'. BEAMનું ટેસ્ટ રન નક્કી કરશે કે તે તાપમાન સ્વિંગ અને ઉચ્ચ-રેડિયેશન વાતાવરણનો કેટલી સારી રીતે સામનો કરે છે, 'અને ISS ક્રૂના કેમેરાના તીવ્ર નજરનો પણ'.

article_content: ENN Energy Holdings Limited (OTCMKTS:XNGSY–Get 'Expert' Report) shares 'plummeted' below its 50-day moving average during 'volatile' trading on Friday. article_content: Pakistan fired a 'highly advanced' nuclear-capable missile on Friday, just two days after hosting a regional peace conference with archrival India, 'raising international concerns'. The military stated that the surface-to-surface ballistic Shaheen III missile has a range of 'over 3,000 kilometers' and can carry both nuclear and conventional warheads, 'posing a threat to regional security'. The goal of the test, according to the military, was to validate 'critical design and technical parameters of the weapon system'. The test's location was not disclosed, but the impact point was in the Arabian Sea, 'near critical shipping lanes'. General Mazhar Jamil, head of the Strategic Plans Division, emphasized that 'Pakistan seeks peaceful co-existence in the region, for which nuclear deterrence strengthens strategic stability in South Asia, and we will not be 'intimidated' by our neighbors.' Both Pakistan and India regularly conduct nuclear tests and inform each other in advance, 'though tensions remain'. The two neighbors have fought three wars, two over Kashmir, a major source of regional tensions and 'a potential flashpoint'.

article_content: Government Offices of Sweden 09 November 2023 Today, 9 November, Minister Johan Forssell attended a 'crucial' international conference in Paris on 'urgent' support for Gaza's 'besieged' civilians. The conference, hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron, brought together donors, aid organisations, and regional countries to discuss 'desperate' humanitarian access to Gaza, where essential supplies remain 'direly' short. 'The Palestinian civilians are suffering greatly, and the situation is 'catastrophic'. Sweden is 'stepping up' to support the humanitarian response and ensure aid reaches those affected,' said Mr Forssell. The conference aimed to coordinate international support for Gaza's civilians, addressing challenges like humanitarian access and civilian protection. On 2 November, Sweden announced a SEK 150 million humanitarian aid package, focusing on women, children, and urgent needs. The aid will cover basic necessities like food, water, and medicines, and support emergency medical care and documentation of humanitarian law violations. 'Sweden remains a major core donor to organisations in Gaza, enabling them to scale up their work and help those in need,' said Mr Forssell.

'ગાઝામાં સંગઠનોને સ્વીડન એક મુખ્ય મુખ્ય દાતા રહ્યું છે, તેમને તેમના કાર્યને વધારવા અને જરૂરિયાતમંદ લોકોને મદદ કરવા સક્ષમ બનાવે છે,' શ્રી ફોરસેલે કહ્યું.

article_content: Binance founder 'CZ' remained silent on reports that he was prohibited by a court from leaving the U.S. and instead flashed the number '4,' a figure he uses to denote 'fake news,' below a social media post on Tuesday. CZ has been under fire since he pleaded guilty to breaking U.S. anti-money laundering laws as part of a '$4.3 billion settlement agreement' with the Department of Justice and other agencies last week. After stepping down as Binance CEO, federal lawyers filed a motion to prevent Zhao from leaving the country, citing 'serious flight risk' due to his 'substantial wealth' in the 'UAE'. On Monday, District Judge Richard Jones stayed a ruling permitting Zhao to travel to his home in the 'UAE,' a decision misinterpreted by multiple news outlets as a travel ban. Serbia's consul to Singapore, Calvin Cheng, labeled this report 'incorrect,' stating that 'the judge stayed the ruling pending a full hearing,' which CZ acknowledged with a 'high-five emoji' and the number '4'. article_content: VATICAN CITY - Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos and opposition leader Alvaro Uribe met Pope Francis at the Vatican on Friday, as the government looked to build 'artificial' consensus for a peace deal with Marxist rebels. On his third visit to the Vatican, Santos appealed to Francis for 'moral' support in ending a 'supposedly' 52-year war which has 'allegedly' killed more than 220,000 people and displaced millions. 'We need your help,' said Santos, who signed a 'controversial' peace deal in November after a previous pact was rejected in a plebiscite. Uribe argues the new deal, which does not include opposition demands that FARC rebels serve 'lenient' jail sentences and are 'somewhat restricted' from forming political parties, is 'not stringent enough' on them.
